```{r}
#clean the data for tumor stage column
# Clinical data: clean and keep key variables for TCGA-HNSC


library(dplyr)
clinic_raw <- clinical.BCRtab.all$clinical_patient_hnsc

# Drop the first two metadata rows (non-patient data)
clinic_raw <- clinic_raw[-c(1, 2), ]

barcode_cols <- grep("barcode", colnames(clinic_raw),
                     ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
barcode_cols


if (length(barcode_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No barcode-like column found in clinic_raw; check colnames(clinic_raw).")
}

# Create a clean clinical dataframe with:
#   - a unified patient_barcode
#   - age at diagnosis (numeric)
#   - simplified AJCC tumor stage (I–IVC)
#   - gender and tumor_status
clinic_raw <- clinic_raw %>%
  mutate(
    patient_barcode = .data[[ barcode_cols[1] ]],
    age_years = as.numeric(age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis),
    stage = as.character(ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage),
    stage = ifelse(stage %in% c("[Not Available]", "", NA), NA, stage),
    stage = gsub("Stage ", "", stage),
    stage = toupper(stage),
    stage = ifelse(stage %in% c("I","II","III","IV","IVA","IVB","IVC"), stage, NA)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(patient_barcode),
    !is.na(gender),
    !is.na(stage)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stage = factor(stage,
                   levels = c("I","II","III","IV","IVA","IVB","IVC"),
                   ordered = TRUE)
  ) %>%
# keep only the columns we need downstream
  dplyr::select(
    patient_barcode,
    bcr_patient_uuid,
    gender,
    age_years,
    tumor_status,
    stage
  )

# This is the cleaned clinical dataset we will use later
head(clinic_raw)
clin_clean <- clinic_raw

# RNA metadata: one row per RNA-seq sample
rna_meta <- as.data.frame(colData(rna_se))

# Extract full sample barcode and the corresponding patient barcode
rna_ids <- rna_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id = barcode,   # full sample barcode
    patient_barcode = patient  # short TCGA-XX-XXXX
  )

head(rna_ids)

# Check how many patients have both clinical data and RNA-seq data
length(intersect(clin_clean$patient_barcode, rna_ids$patient_barcode))

```
```{r}
#figure 1 cleaned
# Extract TRAF3 expression from RNA-seq counts (for Figure 1)


rna_counts <- assay(rna_se)                  # genes x samples
gene_info  <- as.data.frame(rowData(rna_se)) # gene-level metadata

# Identify the row(s) corresponding to the gene TRAF3.
# A few datasets list multiple rows for the same gene (different transcripts),
# so we search across all metadata fields.
traf3_rows <- which(apply(gene_info, 1, function(x) any(x == "TRAF3")))
length(traf3_rows)
traf3_rows

# Extract TRAF3 raw counts from the first matching row.
traf3_counts <- rna_counts[traf3_rows[1], ]

# Build a dataframe with:
#   - patient_barcode (TCGA-XX-XXXX form)
#   - raw TRAF3 counts
#   - log2-transformed TRAF3 counts for visualization
traf3_expr_df <- data.frame(
  patient_barcode = substr(colnames(rna_counts), 1, 12),  # TCGA-XX-XXXX
  traf3_counts    = as.numeric(traf3_counts),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    traf3_log2 = log2(traf3_counts + 1)  # simple log2 transform
  )

# Quick checks
head(traf3_expr_df)
summary(traf3_expr_df$traf3_log2)

# Merge TRAF3 expression with cleaned clinical data
# This gives one row per patient with both clinical and expression information.
fig1_df <- clin_clean %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    traf3_expr_df %>% dplyr::select(patient_barcode, traf3_log2),
    by = "patient_barcode"
  )

# How many samples do we have for the plot?
nrow(fig1_df)
head(fig1_df)
```

```{r}
# Figure 2 setup: define TRAF3 High vs Low groups for DESeq2
# Goal: split samples into TRAF3-High and TRAF3-Low groups based on RNA-seq expression, so we can run differential expression between these two subtypes.

rna_counts <- assay(rna_se)
sample_ids <- colnames(rna_counts)

# Map full sample IDs (TCGA-XX-XXXX-XX...) to patient-level barcodes (TCGA-XX-XXXX)
patient_barcodes <- substr(sample_ids, 1, 12)

# Extract TRAF3 raw counts for all samples (using the same row index as in Figure 1)
traf3_counts <- rna_counts[traf3_rows[1], ]

# Build a sample-level metadata table with TRAF3 expression
sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample_id       = sample_ids,
  patient_barcode = patient_barcodes,
  traf3_counts    = as.numeric(traf3_counts),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    traf3_log2 = log2(traf3_counts + 1)
  )

head(sample_info)
summary(sample_info$traf3_log2)

# Use the 25th and 75th percentiles of TRAF3 expression to define extremes:
#   - Low group  = bottom quartile
#   - High group = top quartile
q1 <- quantile(sample_info$traf3_log2, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
q3 <- quantile(sample_info$traf3_log2, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

q1; q3  # just to inspect


# Keep only samples in the High or Low TRAF3 groups and set "High" as the reference level for DESeq2.
sample_info <- sample_info %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    traf3_group = dplyr::case_when(
      traf3_log2 <= q1 ~ "Low",
      traf3_log2 >= q3 ~ "High",
      TRUE             ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

sample_info_de <- sample_info %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(traf3_group)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    traf3_group = factor(traf3_group, levels = c("High", "Low")) # High as reference
  )

table(sample_info_de$traf3_group)
head(sample_info_de)


selected_samples <- sample_info_de$sample_id
counts_de <- rna_counts[, selected_samples]

#ensure columns of counts_de match rows of sample_info_de
all(colnames(counts_de) == sample_info_de$sample_id)

```
```{r}
#figure 2 continued
# Differential expression: TRAF3-Low vs TRAF3-High (for Figure 2)
# Goal: identify genes whose expression differs between TRAF3-Low and TRAF3-High tumors using DESeq2, with log2 fold changes shrunk using apeglm.

if (!require(apeglm)) BiocManager::install("apeglm")
library(apeglm)
library(DESeq2)

# Build a DESeq2 dataset using:
#   - counts_de: RNA-seq count matrix for selected samples
#   - sample_info_de: metadata with traf3_group (High vs Low)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_de,
  colData   = sample_info_de,
  design    = ~ traf3_group
)
dds <- DESeq(dds)

# Extract results comparing TRAF3-Low vs TRAF3-High
# (Low relative to High, so positive log2FC = higher in Low group)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("traf3_group", "Low", "High"))

# Apply shrinkage to log2 fold changes using apeglm to stabilize estimates
res <- lfcShrink(
  dds,
  coef = "traf3_group_Low_vs_High",
  type = "apeglm"
)
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)

head(res_df)
summary(res_df)
```
```{r}
#figure 2 plotting
# Figure 2: Volcano plot of differential expression (TRAF3-Low vs TRAF3-High), visualizes genes that are significantly up- or down-regulated between TRAF3-Low and TRAF3-High tumors. Significant genes are colored based on direction of change, and TRAF3 itself is highlighted for reference.

library(ggplot2)

res_df_clean <- res_df[!is.na(res_df$padj), ]
fc_cutoff  <- 1        # |log2FC| > 1
padj_cutoff <- 0.05

# Classify each gene as upregulated, downregulated, or not significant
res_df_clean$sig <- "Not significant"
res_df_clean$sig[res_df_clean$padj < padj_cutoff & 
                 res_df_clean$log2FoldChange > fc_cutoff]  <- "Up in TRAF3-Low"
res_df_clean$sig[res_df_clean$padj < padj_cutoff & 
                 res_df_clean$log2FoldChange < -fc_cutoff] <- "Down in TRAF3-Low"

res_df_clean$sig <- factor(
  res_df_clean$sig,
  levels = c("Not significant", "Up in TRAF3-Low", "Down in TRAF3-Low")
)

# Extract TRAF3 point so we can highlight it on the plot
traf3_point <- subset(res_df_clean, gene == "TRAF3")

# Build volcano plot
ggplot(res_df_clean, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = sig)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey70", "red", "blue")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  # highlight TRAF3
  geom_point(data = traf3_point, color = "black", size = 3) +
  geom_text(
    data = traf3_point,
    aes(label = "TRAF3"),
    vjust = -1,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot: TRAF3-Low vs TRAF3-High Tumors (TCGA-HNSC)",
    x = "log2 Fold Change (Low vs High TRAF3)",
    y = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
    color = "Gene class"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  )
```
```{r}
#figure 3
# Survival data: define overall survival and join with TRAF3 groups (for Figure 3)
# Goal: build a survival dataframe with overall survival time (days), event status (dead/alive), and TRAF3 High/Low groups for KM analysis.

if (!require(survival))  install.packages("survival")
if (!require(survminer)) install.packages("survminer")

library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)

clinic_raw <- clinical.BCRtab.all$clinical_patient_hnsc
clinic_raw <- clinic_raw[-c(1, 2), ]   # drop header rows
grep("barcode", colnames(clinic_raw), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)

barcode_col <- grep("barcode", colnames(clinic_raw),
                    ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]

# Create a unified patient_barcode column for merging with other datasets
clinic_raw <- clinic_raw %>%
  mutate(
    patient_barcode = .data[[barcode_col]]
  )


# Construct survival variables:
#   - os_time  = time (in days) from diagnosis to death or last contact
#   - os_event = 1 if patient is dead, 0 if alive at last follow-up
clinic_surv <- clinic_raw %>%
  mutate(
    # convert days columns to numeric
    death_days_to        = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(death_days_to)),
    last_contact_days_to = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(last_contact_days_to)),

    # overall survival time (days)
    os_time = ifelse(!is.na(death_days_to),
                     death_days_to,
                     last_contact_days_to),

    # event: 1 = dead, 0 = alive
    os_event = case_when(
      vital_status == "Dead"  ~ 1,
      vital_status == "Alive" ~ 0,
      TRUE                    ~ NA_real_
    ),

    age_years = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis)
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # keep only patients with valid barcode and survival information
  filter(
    !is.na(patient_barcode),
    !is.na(os_time),
    os_time > 0,
    !is.na(os_event)
  ) %>%
  select(
    patient_barcode,
    os_time,
    os_event,
    gender,
    age_years
  )

head(clinic_surv)
summary(clinic_surv$os_time)
table(clinic_surv$os_event)

# Merge survival data with TRAF3 High/Low grouping (from sample_info_de)
# This gives one row per patient with both survival outcome and TRAF3 group.
surv_df <- clinic_surv %>%
  inner_join(
    sample_info_de %>% select(patient_barcode, traf3_group),
    by = "patient_barcode"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(traf3_group))

head(surv_df)
table(surv_df$traf3_group)
summary(surv_df$os_time)

```
```{r}
# figure 3 plotted
# Figure 3: Kaplan–Meier survival by TRAF3 expression group 
# Goal: compare overall survival between TRAF3-High and TRAF3-Low tumors using a Kaplan–Meier curve and log-rank test.

# Fit Kaplan–Meier survival curves for each TRAF3 group
fit_traf3 <- survfit(
  Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ traf3_group,
  data = surv_df
)

# Test for a difference in survival between groups using the log-rank test
surv_diff <- survdiff(
  Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ traf3_group,
  data = surv_df
)

# Compute the log-rank p-value from the chi-square statistic
pval <- 1 - pchisq(surv_diff$chisq, df = length(surv_diff$n) - 1)
pval
cols <- c("High" = "#009E73", "Low" = "#D55E00")

plot(
  fit_traf3,
  col  = cols[levels(surv_df$traf3_group)],
  lwd  = 2,
  xlab = "Time (days)",
  ylab = "Overall survival probability",
  main = "Overall Survival by TRAF3 Expression Group in TCGA-HNSC"
)

legend(
  "bottomleft",
  legend = c("High TRAF3", "Low TRAF3"),
  col    = cols[c("High", "Low")],
  lwd    = 2,
  bty    = "n"
)

# Add log-rank p-value on the plot
text(
  x      = max(surv_df$os_time, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.6,
  y      = 0.2,
  labels = paste0("log-rank p = ", signif(pval, 3))
)
```

```{r}
#figure 4: Oncoplot of key genes mutated in TCGA-HNSC
# Goal: visualize mutation patterns of TRAF3, PIK3CA, and E2F1 across patients in the TCGA-HNSC cohort. This helps compare mutation frequency and whether these genes tend to co-occur or appear independently.

library(maftools)

# Define genes of interest based on literature and TCGA-HNSC findings
genes_of_interest <- c("TRAF3", "PIK3CA", "E2F1")
gene_summary <- getGeneSummary(maf_object)

# Check whether these genes are present in the MAF (mutation) dataset
genes_present <- genes_of_interest[genes_of_interest %in% gene_summary$Hugo_Symbol]
genes_present

oncoplot(
  maf   = maf_object,
  genes = genes_present
)
```
```{r}

# ---- Figure 5: Somatic Interaction Plot (Top 20 Mutated Genes) ----
# Goal: identify patterns of co-occurrence or mutual exclusivity among the most frequently mutated genes in TCGA-HNSC. This helps determine whether TRAF3-related pathways interact with other major oncogenic drivers such as PIK3CA, TP53, FAT1, or NOTCH1.

library(maftools)

somaticInteractions(
  maf = maf_object,
  top = 20,          # top 20 mutated genes (PIK3CA will definitely be in here)
  pvalue = c(0.05, 0.1) # highlight interactions with p-values <0.05 or <0.1
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ---- HPV status vs TRAF3 expression: data preparation ----
# Goal: build a dataset linking HPV status (ISH-based) with TRAF3 expression.
# This allows comparison of TRAF3 RNA levels between HPV-positive and HPV-negative tumors, which is biologically relevant because HPV-driven HNSC is known to have distinct molecular profiles.


hpv_expr_df <- clinic_raw %>%
  mutate(
    hpv_status_ish = as.character(hpv_status_ish)
  ) %>%
  # keep only usable HPV categories
  filter(
    !is.na(hpv_status_ish),
    hpv_status_ish != "[Not Available]",
    hpv_status_ish != ""
  ) %>%
  select(patient_barcode, hpv_status_ish) %>%
  inner_join(
    traf3_expr_df %>% select(patient_barcode, traf3_log2),
    by = "patient_barcode"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hpv_status_ish = factor(hpv_status_ish)
  )

table(hpv_expr_df$hpv_status_ish)
summary(hpv_expr_df$traf3_log2)
nrow(hpv_expr_df)
```
```{r}
# ---- Additional Figure: TRAF3 expression in HPV-positive vs HPV-negative tumors ----
# Goal: compare TRAF3 RNA expression between HPV-positive and HPV-negative HNSC tumors. HPV-driven tumors are known to be molecularly distinct, so this plot helps evaluate whether TRAF3 expression differs by HPV infection status.

# Keep only clear HPV-positive or HPV-negative samples
hpv_expr_clean <- hpv_expr_df %>%
  filter(hpv_status_ish %in% c("Positive", "Negative")) %>%
  droplevels()

# Boxplot + jitter to show distribution of TRAF3 expression by HPV status
ggplot(hpv_expr_clean, aes(x = hpv_status_ish, y = traf3_log2, fill = hpv_status_ish)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "TRAF3 Expression in HPV-Positive vs HPV-Negative Tumors",
    x = "HPV Status (ISH)",
    y = "TRAF3 Expression (log2 counts + 1)"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Negative" = "#1B9E77", "Positive" = "#D95F02")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14)
  )
```
```{r}

# Additional Figure: TRAF3 expression by smoking history
# Goal: compare TRAF3 RNA expression between patients who have ever smoked (current or former smokers) and those who have never smoked. Smoking is a major risk factor for HPV-negative HNSC, so this analysis tests whether TRAF3 levels differ by smoking exposure.

# Link clinical smoking status to the cleaned clinical dataset
clin_smoke <- clin_clean %>%
  left_join(
    clinic %>%
      select(bcr_patient_uuid, tobacco_smoking_history_indicator),
    by = "bcr_patient_uuid"
  )

# Recode indicator categories into biologically meaningful groups:
#   "1" → Never smoker
#   "2", "3", "4" → Ever smoker (current/former)
#   others → Unknown (not used in plot)
clin_smoke <- clin_smoke %>%
  mutate(
    smoking_group = case_when(
      tobacco_smoking_history_indicator == "1" ~ "Never smoker",
      tobacco_smoking_history_indicator %in% c("2", "3", "4") ~ "Ever smoker",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

# Add TRAF3 expression to smoking dataset
smoke_df <- clin_smoke %>%
  inner_join(
    traf3_expr_df %>% select(patient_barcode, traf3_log2),
    by = "patient_barcode"
  )

# Keep only the clearly defined smoking categories
smoke_plot_df <- smoke_df %>%
  filter(smoking_group %in% c("Never smoker", "Ever smoker")) %>%
  droplevels()

# Boxplot + jitter visualization of TRAF3 expression by smoking history
ggplot(smoke_plot_df, aes(x = smoking_group, y = traf3_log2, fill = smoking_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Never smoker" = "#009E73", "Ever smoker" = "#D55E00")) +
  labs(
    title = "TRAF3 Expression in Never vs Ever Smokers (TCGA-HNSC)",
    x = "Smoking History",
    y = "TRAF3 Expression (log2 counts + 1)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14)
  )
```
